💬Let’s talk تحدّث معي

صفحة 4 من الكتاب — جاليليو يدافع عن نظرياته
1What do you know about Galileo?
2What did he look at the sky with?
Did you know?
  • Galileo did NOT invent the telescope — he built his own after hearing about one.
  • He was the first person to see the moons of Jupiter.
  • He spent the last years of his life under house arrest — and kept writing anyway.

📖Read the text اقرأ النص

Paragraph 1 — A scientist and a telescope

صفحة 5 من الكتاب — مرصد فلكى قديم — كما فى صدر صفحة القراءة
00:00 / 00:00 اسحب على الشريط للتنقّل · اضغط أى كلمة فى النص للانتقال إليها

Galileo Galilei was an Italian scientist and scholar that changed the way the world saw the universe. His studies of physics and mathematics led him to become an astronomer and observer of nature. In 1609, Galileo learned about a telescope that was made by the Dutch eyeglass maker — Hans Lippershey. This discovery changed everything. After learning about this valuable tool for observation, he made his own telescope. Soon after creating his telescope, he began looking at the night skies for clues about the universe.

Paragraph 2 — What Galileo discovered

00:00 / 00:00 اسحب على الشريط للتنقّل · اضغط أى كلمة فى النص للانتقال إليها

At this time in history, the majority of the world believed that the Earth was the centre of the universe and that everything revolved around it. Galileo was able to discover that the moon was not flat, but spherical, and that its surface was not smooth or flat. Galileo also observed the moons of Jupiter, which showed that the Earth was not the only planet with moons.

Paragraph 3 — Followers, trouble and a legacy

صفحة 6 من الكتاب — صورة جاليليو جاليلى
00:00 / 00:00 اسحب على الشريط للتنقّل · اضغط أى كلمة فى النص للانتقال إليها

Galileo wrote a small booklet about his discoveries and he started to gain followers for his theories. Until this time, people followed the theories of Aristotle and Ptolemy. After continuing to observe the universe it became clear that the opinions of Copernicus, who published his work in 1543, were supported by the evidence that Galileo collected. He began to support Copernicus openly and published his new work after seven years of thorough studies. Galileo’s theories were not welcomed by many people. He was sued and sentenced to spend the rest of his life under house arrest. Despite his punishment, he continued his writings and research and eventually became a major contributor to the scientific revolution.

❓Scan the text, then answer اقرأ النص سريعاً ثم أجب

1- Who are the scientists other than Galileo that are mentioned in the text?
اعرض الإجابة
Aristotle, Ptolemy and Copernicus. (Hans Lippershey is also mentioned — he made the first telescope.)
2- In one or two sentences maximum, what is the main idea of the text?
اعرض الإجابة
Galileo used his own telescope to study the sky and proved that the Earth is not the centre of the universe. Although he was punished for his ideas, he became a major contributor to the scientific revolution.

❓Answer the following questions أجب عن الأسئلة الآتية

1- Galileo studied two subjects thoroughly. What were they?
اعرض الإجابة
He studied physics and mathematics.
2- Who invented the telescope?
اعرض الإجابة
Hans Lippershey, a Dutch eyeglass maker.
3- What were the first discoveries Galileo made about the moon and the Earth?
اعرض الإجابة
He discovered that the moon is spherical, not flat, and that its surface is not smooth; and that the Earth is not the only planet with moons.
4- Why was Galileo sued and sentenced?
اعرض الإجابة
Because he supported Copernicus openly and his theories were not welcomed by many people.
5- What was the punishment he received?
اعرض الإجابة
He was sentenced to spend the rest of his life under house arrest.
6- When did Galileo publish his work?
اعرض الإجابة
After seven years of thorough studies.

⚖️Write (True) or (False) صح أم خطأ مع التصحيح

صفحة 7 من الكتاب — تلسكوب المرصد فى القرن التاسع عشر

Correct the false statements.

1- Galileo worked as an astronaut most of his life.
اعرض الإجابة
False — He worked as a scientist, an astronomer and an observer of nature — not an astronaut.
2- Galileo’s theories proved that Earth is at the centre of the Universe.
اعرض الإجابة
False — His theories proved that the Earth is NOT the centre of the universe.
3- Earth is the only planet with moons.
اعرض الإجابة
False — Jupiter also has moons — Galileo observed them himself.
4- Copernicus was one of Galileo’s followers.
اعرض الإجابة
False — Copernicus published his work in 1543, long before Galileo, so Galileo followed and supported Copernicus.
5- Galileo continued studying during his imprisonment.
اعرض الإجابة
True

🎯Write the main idea and give a title الفكرة الرئيسية والعنوان

At this time in history, the majority of the world believed that the Earth was the centre of the universe and that everything revolved around it. Galileo was able to discover that the moon was not flat, but spherical and that its surface was not smooth or flat. Galileo also observed the moons of Jupiter, which showed that the Earth was not the only planet with moons.

Main idea
اعرض الإجابة
Galileo’s observations through his telescope proved that the common belief about the Earth and the moon was wrong.
Title
اعرض الإجابة
Galileo’s Discoveries / A New View of the Universe

❓Think and discuss فكّر وناقش

1- Which paragraph is a key paragraph in the text? Support your answer with reasons.
اعرض الإجابة
Paragraph 2. It contains Galileo’s real discoveries — the moon is spherical and not smooth, and Jupiter has moons — and these are the facts that proved the Earth is not the centre of the universe. Paragraph 1 only prepares for it, and paragraph 3 shows its results.
2- Which of the following statements is correct? (a) clever but lazy (b) problematic and persistent (c) not appreciated at his time (d) his punishment destroyed his career
اعرض الإجابة
(c) Galileo was not appreciated at his time. The text says his theories were not welcomed by many people, and that he was sued and sentenced to house arrest.
